description: When: building or choosing an MCP server. Gives: url → a live server over Streamable HTTP is checked as a client would meet it (handshake or server/discover, tools/list and every definition against the spec, error codes, one read-only tools/call, structuredContent against outputSchema, latency): PASS / FIX / BLOCK with a 0-100 score, INCONCLUSIVE when authorization is required. tools_list → a server it cannot reach (stdio, local, undeployed) is judged on its pasted tools/list answer, an array of tools or one tool, with the same definition rules; strict also requires documentation. Does not prove: that the tools do what their descriptions say.

tools.description: Get one order by its numeric id. Returns its status.
tools.name: get_order

strict.description: With tools_list: every description ≥ 20 characters and every parameter described.

test_tool_args.description: Real arguments, sent to the tested server. Without them, required ones are invented.

test_tool_name.description: Tool to call. Default: a read-only one, preferring no required arg.

tools_list.description: Pasted answer to tools/list (JSON-RPC or its result), an array of tools or one tool, instead of url.

url.description: Public URL of the MCP endpoint (e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp). An origin alone (https://www.ia-qa.com) tries /mcp, then /.

name: mcp_server_evaluate
